feature: The site address on an empty Solo install sends a visitor to the setup wizard
proof: The first and only page load of the recording: the address lands on First-run setup

feature: The theme is chosen with the toggle
proof: Press the theme toggle on the very first screen: the page changes theme (the app starts dark and does not follow the system setting)

feature: The wizard creates the school and its first administrator, then disables itself
proof: Type school name, administrator name, email, setup token, password and its confirmation with key presses; press Complete setup; see 'Setup complete' and continue to sign in

feature: A wrong setup token is refused
proof: Submit with a wrong token: the page says so in a sentence (no status code) and nothing is created

feature: A person signs in with email and password and lands in their school
proof: Type email and password and press Sign in: a person with one school goes straight into it (the dashboard redirects), one with several chooses on the dashboard

feature: A wrong password is refused in one sentence
proof: Type a wrong password: a sentence that does not say whether the account exists, not a status code

feature: Sign out from the account menu
proof: Open the account menu, press Sign out; land on the sign-in page

feature: After signing out, the Back button does not show a school page
proof: Sign out, press Back: the school page's content is not shown again

feature: The overview names the school, the person's role and the campuses (or says there are none)
proof: Sign in: the greeting, the school's name, 'You're signed in as <role>', and the campuses list (an administrator sees all; a campus administrator the one they run); with no campus the page says so

feature: Settings opens from the sidebar for the school administrator
proof: Press Settings in the sidebar: the page opens with its Campuses section and its configuration

feature: A campus is added by typing its name; it is listed and the overview lists it
proof: Type a name, press Add campus: 'Name was added.' and the list (name order); leave and come back: the overview lists both

feature: A campus name the school already has is refused beside the field
proof: Type the same name again: the server's sentence beside the field, the field marked invalid, and no second campus

feature: Changes are staged and counted, and Discard puts everything back
proof: Choose a time zone and flip a switch: '2 unsaved changes'; press Discard: both are as they were and nothing was saved

feature: Saving needs the password again, and a wrong one is refused
proof: Review & Save Changes opens the step-up dialog with the changes listed; a wrong password gives an alert and the dialog stays

feature: A confirmed change is saved, listed in the audit history and still there after leaving the page
proof: Confirm with the right password: the success sentence; the Audit History tab lists each change with who made it and 'Step-up Verified'; leave and come back: the values stay

feature: Users lists the people with a role and the open invitations
proof: Open Users: the People list with each person's role, campus and status, and the invitations still open

feature: An invitation is an email address, a role and a campus
proof: Invite someone: address, role, campus, Send invitation; the notice and the pending row

feature: Revoking an open invitation ends its link
proof: Revoke the invitation sent to a mistyped address: the notice, and the row is gone

feature: An invited person opens the link, chooses a name and a password, and joins
proof: Follow the link in the dev inbox: the school and role are shown; name, password and confirmation by key presses; Create account and join; Continue to sign in

feature: A revoked invitation's link is refused and says what to do
proof: Follow the link of a revoked invitation: 'Ask your school administrator to send a new invitation.'

feature: Every sidebar entry a role may use opens its page and is marked as the current one
proof: Press each entry in turn: the page's heading, and aria-current on the entry; the sidebar has exactly those entries and Overview

feature: An entry a role may not use is not offered
proof: A campus administrator has no Settings; a teacher has no Finance, Users or Settings

feature: The dev email inbox is a stand-in mailbox unlocked with the run's token
proof: Press the envelope: the inbox asks for the dev tools token, unlocks, and lists the school's emails

feature: The account menu says who is signed in and links Profile and the video guide
proof: Open the account menu: the person's address, Profile, Video guide and Sign out

feature: Academic setup has eight sections, as links; a new school's sessions list is empty and says so
proof: Open Academics from the sidebar: the eight section links are listed in order; Sessions & terms opens its list, which says 'No sessions yet.'

feature: A session is created with a name and its first and last day
proof: New session: type the name and both days (as digits), Create session: the notice says it was saved and the row reads Planned and Whole school

feature: An empty session form, and a last day before the first day, are refused in words beside the field
proof: Press Create session on the empty form: both fields say what is missing; type a last day before the first: 'The end must be after the start.'; nothing is saved

feature: A planned session is opened and becomes the Active one
proof: Press Open on the session and confirm: the notice says it is now open and the row reads Active

feature: A term is added to a session and made the current term
proof: Open the session's terms, Add a term with a name and both days, then Make it the current term: the row shows the days and Current, and the session lists '1 term'

feature: A session is copied for next year after a preview, and a second copy of the same year is refused
proof: Copy to next year: Create is disabled until Preview; the preview shows the new name and 'No clashes.'; Create makes a planned session; copying again is refused at the preview with the reason

feature: A class and one arm of it are created; the same arm twice is refused
proof: New class (the empty form is refused first), Add an arm with a capacity: the notice names the arm; adding the same name again says 'That name is already used here.'

feature: Subjects are created (the short code is shown in capitals) and one nobody studies is archived
proof: New subject with a name and a short code: the row shows the code in capitals; create a third and archive it: it leaves the list

feature: A class chooses the subjects it studies
proof: Subjects of the class: tick two subjects and Save subjects; the notice says the class's subjects were saved

feature: A subject a class studies, and a class with arms, cannot be archived: the refusal says why
proof: Archive the subject a class studies: 'A class still studies this subject'; archive the class that has an arm: 'This class still has arms'; nothing is archived

feature: An assessment scheme is created from components and an exam mark, and becomes the school's default
proof: New scheme: a name, the exam mark and one component whose maximum makes the total 100; the card reads School default and Not used yet

feature: A scheme whose parts do not add up to 100 is refused, and the form shows by how much as it is typed
proof: With exam 60 and a component of 30 the form says they add up to 90 of 100; Create scheme is refused at the exam mark in words; correcting the component to 40 says 'that matches'

feature: A grade scale is filled in with one click and saved as the default; the default has no Archive button
proof: New scale: the empty form is refused, type a name, Fill in a standard A-F scale, Create scale: the card reads Default, lists six bands and offers no Archive

feature: People has two lists, Students and Staff; a new school's pupil list is empty and says how to start
proof: Open People from the sidebar: the two section links are listed; Students says 'No students yet. Add the first one, or import a file.'

feature: A pupil is registered with a name and a date of birth and gets the next admission number
proof: Add student: type the names and the date of birth: the notice names the pupil and the admission number, and the list counts them

feature: An empty pupil form is refused in words beside each field
proof: Press Add student on the empty form: first name, last name and date of birth each say what is missing and nothing is saved

feature: The same name and date of birth, in other capital letters, is refused as a pupil that already exists
proof: Add the same pupil in lower and upper case: the form says the pupil already exists and the count does not change

feature: The pupil list is searched by name or number and filtered by class, including 'Not in a class yet'
proof: Type part of a name: one pupil is left; type nonsense: 'No student matches these filters.'; choose 'Not in a class yet': both new pupils are listed

feature: A pupil is enrolled in a class arm for the open session; a class has to be chosen
proof: On the pupil's page press Enrol in a class: without a choice it says 'Choose a class.'; with one the notice says Enrolled and the page lists the class and the session

feature: The first guardian added is the primary contact; a phone number that is too short is refused with the rule in words
proof: Add guardian: the dialog says the first becomes the primary contact; a two-digit phone is refused; a valid one saves and the row reads Primary contact and the relationship with the number

feature: A second guardian is not the primary contact; removing a guardian asks first and says whose guardian they stop being
proof: Add the mother: the father keeps Primary contact; Remove her: the dialog names the pupil; confirm: the row is gone

feature: A parent of two pupils is picked from the register, not typed twice, and the parent's form says the record is shared
proof: On the brother's page Add guardian, choose an existing one, search and pick the father: he is the brother's primary contact; Edit him: the dialog says the record is shared with their other child

feature: A pupil is archived and restored
proof: Archive the pupil: the heading shows Archived; Restore: the notice says Restored and Archive is offered again

feature: A staff record is added; the form says what is missing and refuses a wrong email address
proof: Staff, Add staff member: the empty form says what is missing, 'nope' is refused as an email; a valid one and a campus save: the row reads No sign-in, Teaching and the campus

feature: A staff record is linked to an existing account whose role fits; one has to be chosen
proof: On the record press Link to an existing account: without a choice it says 'Choose who this record is.'; choose the teacher's account: the notice says Account linked and the page says Can sign in

feature: A pupil who signs in before their account is linked to a pupil's record finds nothing, and the portal says the profile is not found
proof: Sign in as the invited pupil: My work, Practice says 'Student profile not found.'; the sidebar has no Finance

feature: A guardian who signs in before their account is linked to a guardian's record sees no child
proof: Sign in as the invited father: My children says 'No pupil is linked to your account yet.'

feature: The administrator links a pupil's sign-in account on the pupil's page; only accounts that sign in as a student are offered, and one has to be chosen
proof: Sign-in section: 'No sign-in yet' says what the pupil lacks; Link opens a dialog that says the account signs in as a student; pressing Link account unchosen says 'Choose who this is.'; choosing the account links it and the section names it

feature: The administrator links a guardian's sign-in account on the guardian's row
proof: On the father's row press Link: the dialog says the account signs in as a parent; choose the account: the row says who he signs in as

feature: Unlinking a pupil's account asks first and says what follows; the account is not switched off and the pupil can be linked again
proof: Unlink: the dialog says the pupil will find nothing in the portal until linked again; confirm: 'Account unlinked.' and 'No sign-in yet'; link again: the section names the account

feature: After the link the pupil's portal answers for them
proof: Sign in as the pupil again: My work, Practice no longer says the profile is not found (it says practice is not ready or is closed, which depends on the question bank)

feature: After the link a guardian's page lists every pupil linked to them, by name and admission number
proof: Sign in as the father again: My children offers both of his children by name and admission number, no longer says no pupil is linked, and says in a sentence that the school keeps guardians' practice view off

feature: A teacher's page lists the subjects they teach, each for a class; the form says what is missing
proof: Add a subject on the teacher's page: the empty form asks for a subject and a class; with both chosen the notice says Added and the list names the subject and the class

feature: A staff record with subjects assigned cannot be archived: the refusal says to remove them first
proof: Archive the teacher: 'Subjects are still assigned to this person. Remove those first.'; cancel: the record is unchanged

feature: A lesson is scheduled from the school's own class arm, subject and teacher
proof: Timetable, Schedule Slot: choose the class arm, subject and teacher, type a room: the lesson is a card on the week, named by what it is

feature: A lesson opens with its own values and a change shows on its card at once
proof: Press the lesson's card: the form holds its room; change it and Update Slot: the card shows the new room

feature: The daily roll lists the pupils enrolled in a class arm; Mark All Present, one pupil set by hand, and it is saved
proof: Attendance: the pupil is listed with their admission number; Mark All Present, set Late, Save Roll Call: 'Attendance saved for'

feature: A teacher is offered only the class arms they teach, and takes the roll of their arm
proof: Sign in as the teacher: Attendance offers only the one class arm assigned to them; Mark All Present and Save Roll Call: 'Attendance saved for'

feature: A teacher can read the setup sections and finds no button that writes
proof: As the teacher open Sessions & terms: the session is listed and there is no New session button

feature: The marks sheet has one column for each part of the school's scheme, for the class the teacher teaches
proof: Sign in as the teacher: Results opens Enter marks; choose the subject: the sheet lists the pupil with columns for the scheme's component and exam and says Not entered

feature: A half-filled row and a mark above its part's maximum say why and stop the save; a typed row shows its total
proof: Type only the component: 'Fill every part, or leave this pupil blank.'; type an exam above 60: 'At most 60.'; Save marks stays disabled; a valid exam shows the running total; Save marks leaves a Draft

feature: Saved marks are sent for review: they become Submitted and the row can no longer be typed into
proof: Send 1 saved for review: the notice says so, the row reads Submitted and its fields are disabled; the same for a second subject

feature: The administrator approves marks on the Review tab
proof: Review: Approve is disabled until a mark is selected; select one: '1 of 2 selected'; Approve: '1 mark moved to approved.'

feature: Returning a mark needs a reason: the dialog will not send without one, and the mark goes back to draft
proof: Select a mark, Return to author: the Return button is disabled until a reason is typed; with the reason: '1 mark moved to draft.'

feature: An approved mark is published from the Approved filter
proof: Choose the Approved status, select the mark, Publish: '1 mark moved to published.'

feature: A report card shows the published mark with its total and the pupil's class
proof: Cards: the class list counts published subjects per pupil; open the card: the term, the subject, the mark out of 100 and the class are there; Back to the class returns to the list

feature: A member of the non-teaching staff has no Marks tab, opens on Review and has no Approve button
proof: Sign in as the non-teaching staff member: Results has no Marks link, Review is the current page, and no Approve button is drawn

feature: A campus administrator sees the Marks, Review and Cards tabs but has no Approve button without the approval permission
proof: Sign in as the campus administrator: three tabs are offered; Review has no Approve button

feature: Finance has three tabs: Invoices, Fee structures and Payment rules
proof: Open Finance from the sidebar: the three tabs are listed and Invoices is selected

feature: A fee is a name, an amount and optionally one class; a fee with no class is charged to every pupil
proof: Fee structures: an empty list says so; Add Fee Schedule with a name, an amount and a class: the row says the class only; one with no class says All Classes

feature: The term's invoices are generated for every enrolled pupil from the fees that apply to them
proof: Generate Term Invoices: choose the term and a due date: the dialog says one new invoice was generated and the pupil's row reads Unpaid

feature: An invoice's page says how it may be paid; the administrator requires payment in full on it and allows parts again
proof: Open the invoice (View & Pay): 'Part payments are allowed'; Require payment in full: the notice and the region say so; Allow part payments: the button to require it is back

feature: A part payment received at the bursary is recorded with its channel and a receipt is issued; the invoice becomes partly paid
proof: Record Payment: an amount and the Cash channel, Record Payment & Issue Receipt: the status reads PARTIALLY PAID and the payment ledger is on the page

feature: A discount with an amount and a reason is applied to an invoice and listed on it
proof: Apply Discount: an amount and a reason: the discounts and waivers list shows the reason

feature: The school's rule on the smallest part is changed with the administrator's password, and the page then says it
proof: Payment rules: Smallest part an amount, 2000, Save the rule: the dialog asks for the account password; confirm: 'The school's rule saved.' and the rule's sentence names the amount

feature: A campus administrator reads the school's rule and has no button to change it
proof: Sign in as the campus administrator: Payment rules says only the school's administrator changes a rule and offers no Save the rule button

feature: The broadcast composer: channel, audience, a personalised tag added by its chip, Clear, and a confirmation that says who the message goes to
proof: Write an email to the staff, add the school-name tag with its chip, press Clear (subject and text empty), write it again; Dispatch Broadcast shows 'Audience: STAFF (All Campuses)'; Confirm & Send moves to the delivery log

feature: A broadcast that reaches nobody says nothing was sent and why, keeps what was written and stays on the composer
proof: Send an email to the parents, who have phone numbers and no email addresses: a warning says 'Nothing was sent. 2 people in this audience have no email address on record.', no 'queued successfully', the composer tab stays and the text is kept

feature: A text message to the parents has no subject, takes the pupil's name by its chip, and is sent to the phone numbers on record
proof: Choose SMS (the subject field goes), write the text, add the pupil-name tag with its chip; the confirmation says 'Channel: SMS'; Confirm & Send moves to the delivery log and no warning is shown

feature: The delivery log lists every message with its status, channel and recipient, is narrowed by status, channel and a recipient search, and opens one message
proof: Filter by SENT, by the SMS channel (the staff email goes), search 'chidi' (the phone number goes), search a stranger (the empty-list sentence), open one message: its recipient and subject are shown

feature: The message templates are listed by channel and searched, previewed with sample values, and customised (name and wording)
proof: Choose EMAIL and search 'absence' (the other templates go), open Preview, then Customize, rename the template and save: the success line and the new name on the card

feature: A template name that is too short is refused and the dialog keeps what was typed
proof: Customize a template, type a one-letter name and save: an alert is shown, the dialog stays open with the typed name; Cancel leaves the template as it was

feature: A teacher is offered no Communication, and its address shows the page for someone with no access
proof: Sign in as the teacher: the sidebar has no Communication; typing the address in a new tab shows 'You don't have access to this school'

feature: A campus administrator is offered their own campus and its classes only, reaches that campus's staff, and the delivery log hides messages about people of the whole school
proof: Sign in as the campus administrator: Campus Scope lists their campus only and Class Arm only 'All Classes'; an email to the staff says 'Audience: STAFF (Campus: North Campus)' and is logged; the parents' phone number (messages the school sent about pupils of no campus) is not in the log

feature: A campus administrator cannot write to the parents of pupils who belong to the whole school: the audience is empty and the page says so
proof: As the campus administrator send an SMS to Parents / Guardians: 'Nothing was sent: nobody is in this audience.'

feature: A teacher finds Browse, My questions and My reports, and none of the sections for reviewers and administrators
proof: Sign in as the teacher and open Question bank: the section tabs are Browse, My questions and My reports; Browse is selected

feature: An empty question form is refused and lists what is missing
proof: Write a question and press Save as a draft with nothing filled in: an alert lists the problems and nothing is saved

feature: A question with one correct answer is written with its options, explanation, points, difficulty, topic, subject and class, and saved as a draft
proof: Fill the form (four options, Option 2 marked correct, explanation, points, difficulty, topic, subject, the class as a tag) and Save as a draft: 'Saved as a draft', and My questions lists it as 'Draft · One correct answer'

feature: A true-or-false question and a short-answer question (with several accepted answers) are written and saved as drafts
proof: Choose Kind of question True or false, mark False and save; choose Short answer, give two accepted answers (Add another accepted answer) and save: My questions lists 'Draft · True or false' and 'Draft · Short answer'

feature: A draft is changed and sent for review, and then shows as waiting for review
proof: Open a draft, Edit, change the points, Save changes ('Saved.'); Send for review: 'Sent for review. A reviewer will look at it.' and the list says 'Waiting for review'

feature: The reviewer finds the questions waiting in the Review queue and approves one, confirming its subject and classes
proof: Open the Review queue: the three waiting questions are listed; open one, Approve: 'Approve this question' asks for the subject (already filled) and classes; Approve takes it off the queue

feature: A question is sent back with a reason, and a reviewer cannot send one back without a reason
proof: Open a waiting question, Send back, press Send back with no reason: 'Give a reason.'; type a reason and Send back: the question leaves the queue

feature: The writer sees each question in the state the reviewer left it, narrows the list by state, and reads the reason a question was sent back
proof: My questions: Approved, Sent back and Waiting for review; State 'Sent back' shows only that one; opening it shows the reviewer's reason

feature: The school's administrator is offered every section: Review queue, Reports, Print log, Reviewers and Settings as well as the writer's three
proof: Sign in as the school administrator and open Question bank: the tabs are Browse, My questions, My reports, Review queue, Reports, Print log, Reviewers and Settings
